title: Sherrod Brown Seeks Senate Comeback in Ohio, Hoping His Populist Pitch Still Resonates
summary: At 73, Sherrod Brown is mounting a comeback bid in Ohio. He is one of the Democrats his party is counting on to retake control of the Senate.
